gpu_tip: ~35GB total at 128K context. Only 16 of Qwen3.8's 64 layers carry a real KV cache thanks to its hybrid Gated DeltaNet design, so an 8GB GPU (e.g. RTX 3060 Ti) plus ~32GB of DDR5 system RAM is enough, with llama.cpp's layer offloading filling in the gap.
mac_tip: Needs ~35GB — fits a 48GB MacBook Pro (M4 Pro/Max or M5 Pro/Max) comfortably; a 36GB config is tight.
